description:
Everything held for one domain in a single call: the record, registration timing, every address it has resolved to (each with the network behind it), and every certificate covering it with its SAN list. NEEDS AN API KEY ON THE PLUS PLAN OR ABOVE; lookup_domain is the free summary.

Each address carries current (resolves there now) and network: ASN, organisation, announced range, country and reverse DNS, with network.status found, none or unavailable. "unavailable" means the enrichment could not be fetched this time, not that the address has no network; network_lookup counts how many of each.

The same caution as lookup_domain applies to nulls: a null registration date is "not held", never "not registered". Accepts a hostname or a URL; a subdomain is answered for its registrable domain. A domain with no record returns a not-found result, which means not held, not unregistered.

Choose it when you need the certificates or the networks behind the addresses; for many domains at once use lookup_domains, and for the dated order of events use domain_timeline.

domain.description: A domain name or a URL containing one, e.g. "github.com".
